about_the_game:
A NEW AND EXCITING ACTION PUZZLE EXPERIENCE!

Welcome to the world of Kyubu Kyubu Dice, an easy-to-learn yet hard-to-master action puzzle game! Roll your magical dice and match the colors with the panels that appear on the stage. Each roll challenges your quick thinking and ability to plan ahead as the game becomes more intense the longer you play.

Suitable for players of all ages, you can play solo or compete with friends in multiplayer mode! Test your spatial thinking and challenge yourself as you carefully plan each move. With a variety of game modes to explore, there's always a fresh way to play!

A CAST OF UNIQUE CHARACTERS TO CHOOSE FROM!

Featuring a vibrant cast of appealing characters, each designed in a charming anime style to match the game's aesthetic. From the energetic and cheerful to the cool and mysterious, every character brings their own personality to the stage. To make the experience even more immersive, all characters are fully voiced in Japanese, enhancing the authentic anime-inspired feel.

COMPETITIVE MULTIPLAYER!

Want to challenge your friends and show them who’s the best? Jump into multiplayer modes where quick thinking and clever plays make all the difference! Battle it out in head-to-head matches or compete for high scores. Whether you’re aiming for the top of the leaderboards or just having fun with friends, there’s a mode for every kind of player. Try different rulesets and strategies—no two matches are ever the same!

WISHLIST & FOLLOW FOR MORE UPDATES!

Kyubu Kyubu Dice is still in development, so you can expect a lot more content at launch! Make sure to wishlist and follow the game so you don't miss any updates.

Always remember — you’re the best! 🎲💫

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTS 750, 1GB or Radeon HD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX0.9c

short_description: Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an action puzzle game where you roll a magical die to match and clear colorful panels. Easy to pick up, but challenging to master! Whether you're playing casually or battling friends, it's a fun and addictive puzzle experience!
